title: Normalized ring compact-support scalar comparison cocycles
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p\ne\ell$, finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$ and a separated finite-type $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. No absolute separatedness of the schemes is imposed. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories $C_s(T)=D^b_{ctf}(T,s)$ [def-sf-categories], completed at integral stages and with positive finite levels $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ ($E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $n\ge1$) [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].
Fix a compactification $c=(j,p_c)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $s$ range over finite and integral coefficient stages, with ring sheaves $R_{s,T}$, their compatible pull identifications, and compatible maps of these sheaves as in [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Put $H_s=Rp_{c,*,s}j_{!,s}$ and $S_a^T=-\otimes^L_{R_{s,T}}R_{t,T}$ for a map $a:s\to t$. Let $Q_a:S_a^YH_s\to H_tS_a^X$ be the proper coefficient mate after the open tensor comparison specified there. Write $\tau_T:S_b^TS_a^T\cong S_d^T$ for balanced tensor associativity when $d=ba$, and $v_T:S_1^T\cong1$ for multiplication.

For all composable compatible coefficient maps, including nonflat finite quotients and mixed integral/finite composites, the following equalities hold in the target ring's ordinary derived category:
$$H_r(\tau_X)Q_b(S_a^X)S_b^Y(Q_a)=Q_d\tau_Y(H_s),\qquad H_s(v_X)Q_1=v_Y(H_s).$$
Suppose additionally that $I_{s,T}:C_s(T)\to D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},R_{s,T})$ is the full inclusion, $F_s:C_s(X)\to C_s(Y)$ is realized by $r_s:I_{s,Y}F_s\cong H_sI_{s,X}$, and $T_a^T:C_s(T)\to C_t(T)$ is realized by $\sigma_a^T:I_{t,T}T_a^T\cong S_a^TI_{s,T}$. Suppose given $q_a:T_a^YF_s\cong F_tT_a^X$ satisfying
$$H_t(\sigma_a^X)r_t(T_a^X)I_t(q_a)=Q_a(I_s)S_a^Y(r_s)\sigma_a^Y(F_s).$$
Let $\alpha_T:T_b^TT_a^T\cong T_d^T$ and $u_T:T_1^T\cong1$ be isomorphisms whose realizations through $\sigma$ are exactly $\tau_T$ and $v_T$. Then the specified restricted maps satisfy
$$F_r(\alpha_{X,K})q_{b,T_a^XK}T_b^Y(q_{a,K})=q_{d,K}\alpha_{Y,F_sK},\qquad F_s(u_{X,K})q_{1,K}=u_{Y,F_sK}$$
for every $K\in C_s(X)$. These equations depend only on the actual ring maps and the stated realizations, including when an allowed map has different proofs of being allowed. No invertibility of the ambient proper mate on arbitrary inputs is required.

proof.text: Apply the already stated ordinary-derived comparison_composition and comparison_identity in [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] to the three actual ring sheaf maps. Their signatures quantify over arbitrary coefficient systems and arbitrary derived objects, with no flatness, preservation, invertibility or absolute separatedness assumption. They give ambient_composition and ambient_identity exactly.

proof.text: For restricted composition, apply the faithful target full inclusion [def-sf-categories]. Postcompose both sides with the isomorphism r_D(T_d K) followed by H_r(sigma_d K). Naturality of r_D moves the restricted X-associator into H_r; Associator.normalized replaces its realization by the two successive sigma maps followed by tensorComposition. Substitute Normalized for q_b. Naturality of sigma_b^Y at q_a and of the ambient comparison for b at sigma_a^X lets functoriality collect Normalized for q_a. Substitute the ambient composition equation from Step 1. On the other side substitute Normalized for q_d and Associator.normalized on Y; naturality of the Y tensor associator at r_A identifies the resulting expressions. Cancel the realization isomorphism and use faithfulness.

source.place: Existing compact-support scalar mate composition and identity, followed by faithful-realization calculations from the original node Steps 4–6.

proof.text: For each identity clause first use pointwise equality of maps and proof irrelevance of Change.square to identify the given compatible change with the explicitly constructed identity change. Equality transports then become reflexive. For the unit equation apply the faithful inclusion and postcompose with r_A(K). Naturality of r_A and Unit.normalized on X identify the left side with Normalized for q followed by H_s of scalar multiplication. Substitute Normalized and ambient_identity from Step 1. Naturality of the ambient tensor unitor at r_A identifies the result with Unit.normalized on Y followed by r_A. Cancel r_A. For uniqueness apply isomorphism and natural-transformation extensionality. At each K apply the faithful inclusion and postcompose by r_B(T_a K) followed by H_t(sigma_a K). The two Normalized hypotheses give identical composites, and that suffix is invertible.

Q148 created this item in its re-split of lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-coherence, and it carries the parent's old steps 1-3 in full. There is no repair note for this item, so the re-split rule does not apply to it. Step 1 is correct. lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization applies with g=id and ring map a, so its beta is the item's beta_a, and it gives that the restricted beta is the identity and that j_! is fully faithful for arbitrary ring sheaves. Maps out of an object in the image of j_! are detected after restriction to the open, and the source is in that image. lem-pur-coefficient-pullback-coherence (setting def-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-data, insertion-normalized comparisons) then makes the restricted maps commute with the associators and units. Step 2 is correct. The chi of lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-cocycle is the item's counit mate. Its cocycle and unit equations match the ones displayed, and it assumes no flatness or invertibility. Steps 3-6 are elementary and I recomputed all of them. Step 3: naturality of chi_b at beta_a, then Steps 1 and 2, give Q_d tau_Y(H_s); the unit case also checks. Step 4: I typed A_ba and B_ba from source to target. Naturality of Q_b at sigma_a and of sigma_b at q_a gives the stated equation. Steps 5-6: the realization equations for alpha and u, plus naturality of r and tau, cancel the isomorphism A_d (or r_s); faithfulness comes from the full-inclusion hypothesis and def-sf-categories. The uniqueness formula q_a = A_a^{-1} Q_a B_a holds without inverting Q_a. Edge cases checked: j=id, p=id, a=1 or b=1, empty X, and Z/8->Z/4->Z/2.     (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    Laws.{u, v} l Ω c
